exposure: Routine prophylactic Bakri balloon tamponade after placental removal
Major and minor placenta previa groups
Placenta previa severity: Major vs Minor
outcome: Frequency of massive postpartum hemorrhage (>500 ml)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies that involved cesarean section for placenta previa
finding: Routine prophylactic use of Bakri balloon tamponade during and after cesarean section is effective in controlling blood loss in major placenta previa.
mod_finding: Routine prophylactic use of a Bakri balloon tamponade during and after cesarean section is effective in controlling blood loss in major placenta previa.
